items.exampleEn: In my parents' eyes, his silence was tantamount to a yes.
items.exampleZh: 在我爸媽看來，他的沉默就等於答應了。

items.exampleEn: Rumors often grow through amplification on social media.
items.exampleZh: 謠言常常因為在社群媒體上被放大而越傳越大。

items.exampleEn: The rules are amply explained on the first page.
items.exampleZh: 第一頁已經把規則說明得很充分。

items.exampleEn: The internet seems to be an inexhaustible source of information.
items.exampleZh: 網路似乎是取之不盡的資訊來源。

items.exampleEn: Cats elongate their bodies when they stretch.
items.exampleZh: 貓伸懶腰時會把身體拉長。

items.exampleEn: We should design public spaces inclusively, with ramps and wide doors.
items.exampleZh: 我們應該以包容的方式設計公共空間，加裝斜坡和寬門。

items.exampleEn: One acre is about four thousand square meters.
items.exampleZh: 一英畝大約是四千平方公尺。

items.exampleEn: Some athletes bulk up before the season starts.
items.exampleZh: 有些運動員會在賽季開始前增加肌肉量。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle's farm covers about two hundred acres.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔的農場面積大約兩百英畝。

items.audioEn: In this small room, the singer's voice needs no amplification.
items.audioZh: 在這個小房間裡，歌手的聲音不需要擴音。
items.questionZh: 為什麼歌手的聲音不需要擴音？

items.sentenceEn: Ignoring the warning is tantamount to breaking the rule.
items.sentenceZh: 無視警告就等於違反規定。

items.sentenceEn: Good teachers speak inclusively so that every student feels welcome.
items.sentenceZh: 好老師說話時會照顧到每個人，讓每個學生都覺得受歡迎。

items.stemEn: Her energy seemed ____; she worked all day and then danced all night.
items.stemZh: 她的精力似乎用不完；她工作了一整天，接著又跳舞跳了一整晚。

items.stemEn: In winter, the shadows ____ because the sun stays low in the sky.
items.stemZh: 冬天時，因為太陽在天空中的位置比較低，影子會拉長。

items.passageEn: My uncle owns a farm of about fifty acres in the south. For years, people told him that small farms could not survive, and that refusing to grow rice was tantamount to giving up. He ignored them and planted fruit trees instead. His decision has more than paid off: his mangoes now sell in shops across the island. Last year, he embarked on a new plan to increase his income by adding a small cafe. On weekends, it holds small concerts that need no amplification. His energy seems inexhaustible; at seventy, he still starts work at five every morning.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔在南部有一座大約五十英畝的農場。多年來，大家都跟他說小農場撐不下去，不種稻米就等於放棄。他不理會這些話，改種果樹。他的決定得到了充分的回報：他的芒果現在在全島的商店都買得到。去年，他展開一項新計畫，加開一間小咖啡館來增加收入。週末時，咖啡館會舉辦不需要擴音的小型音樂會。他的精力似乎用不完；七十歲了，每天早上還是五點就開始工作。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔沒有聽別人的話，而是做了什麼？
去年他做了什麼來增加收入？

items.promptZh: 你的努力已經得到充分的回報。
referenceEn: Your hard work has been amply rewarded.
Your efforts have been amply rewarded.
rubricZh: amply 表示「充分地」，用法例如 amply rewarded、amply paid 等
「努力」可寫，例如 hard work、efforts 等
「得到回報」可寫，例如 has been rewarded、has paid off 等

items.promptZh: 編輯請作者再多加幾個例子，讓這一章更充實。
referenceEn: The editor asked the writer to bulk up the chapter with more examples.
The editor asked the author to add a few examples to bulk up the chapter.
rubricZh: 「讓⋯更充實」用 bulk up（例如 bulk up the chapter 等）
「多加幾個例子」可寫，例如 with more examples、add a few more examples 等
時態配合內容（例如 asked、asks 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似搭配不自然：bulk up his business by adding a small cafe——bulk up 多指增加體積／肌肉或內容份量，用在「擴大事業」較牽強（expand／grow his business 較道地）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "to bulk up his income by adding a small cafe"，中譯與閱讀第 2 小題同步改「增加收入」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 nonprofessional、demographically、straightforward 為冷僻或跨課重複字，一眼可排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 改為先前課形容詞 negligible、bulky、marginal（與「工作一整天又跳舞一整晚」矛盾）；不用 staggering

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 干擾項 hibernate 為 u18 才教、concentrate 為 A2 字
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 plummet、proliferate（先前課不及物動詞，「影子驟降／激增」不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：bulk up 釋義第一義「增大、充實」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「增加肌肉量；增大、充實」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：amply 表示「充分地」，用法例如 amply rewarded、amply paid 等／「努力」可寫，例如 hard work、efforts 等／「得到回報」可寫，例如 has been rewarded、has paid off 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：bulk up＋受詞表示「使變大、充實」（例如 bulk up my presentation 等）／時態配合內容（例如 want to bulk up、bulked up 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（bulk up）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u05-l03-q17；目標字沿用 bulk up
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「編輯請作者再多加幾個例子，讓這一章更充實。」、hintWords ["bulk up"]、referenceEn ["The editor asked the writer to bulk up the chapter with more examples.","The editor asked the author to add a few examples to bulk up the chapter."]、rubricZh ["「讓⋯更充實」用 bulk up（例如 bulk up the chapter 等）","「多加幾個例子」可寫，例如 with more examples、add a few more examples 等","時態配合內容（例如 asked、asks 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 bulk up 造一個句子，說說你想讓自己的某樣東西（例如報告、簡報）變得更充實。」、referenceEn ["I want to bulk up my presentation with a few more examples.","I need to bulk up my report before the meeting on Friday."]）
